ui.add.how: you pick a version of the lyrics; EncoLibMG looks on YouTube for audio with the same length (so the lyrics line up), splits the vocals from the instrumental on your GPU and saves everything in the format Encore understands: guide vocal on/off, scoring and word-by-word lyrics.
ui.add.mtv_lead: Karaoke videos with the lyrics burned in. They work in Encore without an .lrc.
ui.add.need_artist_title: Type “Artist - Song” so I can name the video.
ui.add.none_text: Try another spelling or look for a karaoke video.
ui.add.search_failed: The lyrics search failed. Check your connection.
ui.add.sub: Pick the synced lyrics; the rest is automatic.
ui.add.wait_job: Wait for the current job to finish.
ui.check.clean: No problems: the library is in great shape.
ui.check.sub: Finds what Encore would ignore or show wrong, and fixes it.
ui.check.what.1d: Encore won’t show it; I find lyrics by length
ui.check.what.2d: builds notes and words for the guide and scoring
ui.check.what.3d: rewrites them in the format Encore reads
ui.check.what.5d: Encore only reads the root; moves it there
ui.check.what.6d: without it the MTV category doesn’t show
ui.check.what.7d: writes artist and title into the mp3
ui.guide.help: The bars are the notes Encore uses for the pitch guide and scoring; the lyrics light up word by word, just like there. Listen to {voice} only to check that the notes follow the singing. In Encore, {key} → Guide plays this melody.
ui.guide.pick: Pick a track with a guide in the {link}.
